mapper.sql: select id, activity_id, round_id, object_id, reviewer_count, submitted_count, calculated_score, calculated_grade, calculated_rank, evaluation_conclusion, conclusion_generated_by, conclusion_generated_time, result_status, generated_by, generated_time, published_by, published_time, revoked_by, revoked_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag from review_result
mapper.select: select r.id as recordId, r.assignment_id as assignmentId, r.reviewer_id as reviewerId, r.reviewer_user_id as reviewerUserId, coalesce(rp1.reviewer_name, rp2.reviewer_name, concat('用户', r.reviewer_user_id)) as reviewerName, r.record_status as recordStatus, r.total_score as totalScore, r.grade as grade, r.recommendation as recommendation, r.comment_text as commentText, r.submitted_time as submittedTime from review_record r left join reviewer_profile rp1 on rp1.id = r.reviewer_id and rp1.del_flag = '0' left join reviewer_profile rp2 on rp2.user_id = r.reviewer_user_id and rp2.del_flag = '0' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.round_id = #{roundId} and r.object_id = #{objectId} order by r.submitted_time desc, r.id desc
